The facilitator kept calling out the time left, and each call carried the same rule: when time was up, the start domino would be pushed, and only what was connected to it would fall. When the push came, the whole picture went down. The result was 30 of 30 fell, so every piece was connected to the start.

Priya said the picture was a fish. The blind judges saw something else. They guessed a curved line of fallen dominoes, a dashed arc, or a bent road or river. One described a hook-shaped stroke ending in a short horizontal bar. Another guessed a bent wire or track with a horizontal end piece.

The turning point came at the final push, when the connected chain carried every domino down together. Priya's fish stayed in her mind, while the judges read the fall as a line, a hook, and a track.
